science.qualification: Infrared false colour of the whole disc from published flux densities (Liu Dupuy & Allers (2016); Dupuy & Liu (2012), as compiled in Best, Liu, Magnier & Dupuy (2024), The UltracoolSheet v2.1 (Zenodo); zero points from the SVO Filter Profile Service, UltracoolSheet Main.csv, AB Pic b: MKO K 13.73 +/- 0.10 (Liu_16), H 14.74 +/- 0.10 (Dupu12), J 15.46 +/- 0.14 (Liu_16); SVO MKO/NSFCam.K 638.2 Jy, MKO/NSFCam.H 1034.8 Jy, MKO/NSFCam.J 1544.0 Jy): red MKO K 2.184 µm, green MKO H 1.614 µm, blue MKO J 1.2417 µm, on one range shared with the bodies the record names. The planet is unresolved, so no map is implied. It glows with its own heat, so no lighting.
